action: Find EasyIO FW controllers running firmware V3.0b25 or earlier, read the Johnson Controls product security advisory linked from the Cyber Centre notice and apply the vendor's update.
exec: Building-automation controllers from Johnson Controls need a firmware update; no exploitation is reported in the Canadian advisory.
plain: Canada's cyber agency told operators of Johnson Controls EasyIO building-control devices that older firmware has a security flaw and should be updated.

key_findings: The advisory is filed under the Cyber Centre's control systems series.
Affected: Johnson Controls EasyIO FW at version V3.0b25 or earlier.
The page names no CVE and gives no technical description; details are in the linked Johnson Controls notice.
The advisory makes no statement about exploitation.
recommendations: Review the Johnson Controls notice and product security advisories page linked from the advisory.
Apply the necessary updates as they become available.

summary: Cyber Centre control systems advisory AV26-1158 says Johnson Controls EasyIO FW firmware at version V3.0b25 or earlier is affected by a vulnerability the vendor has confirmed. The advisory links to a Johnson Controls product security notice for the details. It names no CVE and makes no statement about exploitation.
title: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security issues control systems advisory AV26-1158 on Johnson Controls EasyIO

validation.note: Reviewed against the original Canadian Centre for Cyber Security document.

review.note: Compared EasyIO FW V3.0b25 or earlier, vendor confirmation, no CVE against CCCS AV26-1158
